title: How to Check a Freelance Delivery Before You Accept It
h1: How to check a freelance delivery before you accept it
description: A practical checklist for reviewing finished freelance work: files, formats, quality, rights, accounts and handover, so nothing is missing after you approve.
intro: Accepting a delivery usually closes the order, and asking for changes afterwards often means a new order. A careful final check takes a few minutes and prevents most later problems: missing files, wrong formats, spelling mistakes, unclear rights or accounts you cannot access. This article gives you a general checklist plus extra points for design, writing, video and websites.

faq.q: How long do I have to review a delivery?
faq.a: It depends on the platform's rules. Check the order page, and do not leave it until the last moment.

faq.q: What if a file is missing after I accepted?
faq.a: Message the seller politely. Many will send it, but it is easier to check before accepting.

faq.q: Should I test the work on other devices?
faq.a: Yes, especially websites, apps, emails and videos.

faq.q: Do I need the source files?
faq.a: If you may want to edit the work later, yes. Check whether your package includes them.

faq.q: Where should I store the files?
faq.a: In at least two places, such as your computer and a cloud folder you control.
